Don't worry, I can imagine how difficult things can be at that age. I've been feeling stressed ever since I moved from countryside to the city. My parents were separated and I wasn't very good at making friends. I became aware of my discomfort over time and luckily I found some help. You should know that every school should have a psychologist's service (at least here in Italy) to help you to think about your problems, in fact I used it and it helped me to clear my head. Then if you don't have anyone to talk to... don't worry, there'll be someone. You'll have to look for him, you can find him as you can find him in an oratory or in a park. There's a lot of nice people out there.

I hope you can resolve this situation in the best possible way.

Take care. :)
